name: Shen'dralas
summary: Centaur, outcasts, and quilboar contest Shen'dralas, south east of desolace. Ancient ruins rise among its crags, between Feralas and Mulgore.

sections.title: A Borderland in Turmoil
sections.body: Shen'dralas lies in the heights south east of desolace, between Mulgore and Feralas. Its craggy passes and hidden enclaves shelter groups struggling to survive far from the great faction capitals. At Evenshade Overlook, some watch from secluded heights. At Outcast Hideaway, others seek refuge where they can be forgotten.

sections.title: Centaur, Quilboar, and Ancient Ruins
sections.body: Ancient ruins recall the highborne legacy behind Shen'dralas's name, yet the land is far from peaceful. Centaur feuds spill across the Magram Front, keeping old bloodshed alive along the borders. Bristleback quilboar hold fortified ground at Bristleback Retreat. Travelers find contested territory in the ravines.

sections.title: The Valley of Bones
sections.body: The valley of bones leads north-west toward Desolace and offers the main overland route into Shen'dralas. Sun and wind have bleached the passage. Its bones recall the violent struggles that still sweep through these crags.

faq.answer: Shen'dralas lies south east of Desolace, between Feralas and Mulgore. Travelers on foot usually enter from Desolace through the Valley of Bones.

faq.q: Is Shen'dralas controlled by the Alliance or the Horde?
faq.answer: Neither the Alliance nor the Horde holds Shen'dralas. Roving centaur, hostile quilboar, outcasts, and isolated encampments make it a contested frontier.

faq.q: What major settlements or landmarks are here?
faq.answer: The main landmarks are the Valley of Bones, Bristleback Retreat, Evenshade Overlook, the Magram Front, Outcast Hideaway, and Shen'dralas's central expanse.
Centaur territorial wars reach from Desolace's plains into Shen'dralas along the Magram Front. There, the clan clashes with local defenders and rival factions.
Bristleback Retreat is a fortified outpost held by Bristleback quilboar. They have secured a fierce foothold along the zone's edges.

faq.q: What is the connection between this zone and Lake Dumont?
faq.answer: There is no known connection. Shen'dralas has its own landmarks, such as the Valley of Bones and Outcast Hideaway.

angles.text: As a night elf, Shen'dralas's name recalls the ancient Highborne lore of Eldre'Thalas. Sentinels wary of reckless arcana in southern Kalimdor watch with interest.
As a tauren, Shen'dralas borders Mulgore and Desolace. Quilboar and centaur aggression along its ridges threatens nearby ancestral hunting grounds.
As an Alliance traveler, you cross a remote, contested wilderness with alternate routes between Feralas and central Kalimdor. Travel calls for keen vigilance.
As a member of the Horde, you find Shen'dralas just beyond Mulgore's southern reaches. Keeping the Magram and quilboar contained there helps protect Horde frontiers.
